
```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(participant_id) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```

Look at number of replications per treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Look at number of participants per version x treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Plot of all of that...

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  filter(theta != "0") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = n, 
             fill = version)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "identity", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = "Number of Participants who evaluated the lineup",
       subtitle = str_c("By ", "<span style = 'color:#1B9E77'>**version A**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#D95F02'>**version B**</span>")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

Look at correctness

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +

       ) +
```

```{r}
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  group_by(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = prop_correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#1F87B4") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14)
        )
```

## Binomial GLMM

| Source of Variation                               | Degrees of Freedom (2520 - 1) = 2519 |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| participant_id                                    | (210 - 1) = 209                      |
| theta                                             | (6 - 1) = 5                          |
| cpLoc                                             | (3 - 1) = 2                          |
| sigma                                             | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| theta x cpLoc                                     | (6 - 1)(3 - 1) = 10                  |
| theta x sigma                                     | (6 - 1)(2 - 1) = 5                   |
| cpLoc x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc x sigma                             | (6 - 1)(3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 10           |
| participant_id x theta x cpLoc x sigma - residual | ... = 2275 ???                       |
|                                                   |                                      |

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
library(lme4)
# library(afex)
# library(jtools)
library(emmeans)

# mod <- glmer(correct ~ theta + sigma + cpLoc + theta:sigma + theta:cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
#              family = binomial(),
#              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
#                                     optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
#              ),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# 
# mod <- glmer(correct ~ (1 |theta) + (1 | sigma) + (1|cpLoc) + (1|theta:sigma) + (1|theta:cpLoc)  + (1 | participant_id),
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# 
# summary(mod)
# mod |> profile() |> confint()
# 
# 
# mod <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + lineup_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# 
# mod <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id + lineup_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# 

# mod_glm <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# aov(mod_glm) |>
#   summary()

mod <- glmer(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

summary(mod)
car::Anova(mod)
anova(mod)
# summ(mod)
```

## Results

```{r}
estimates <- emmeans(mod, ~ theta:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T))

estimates |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(cpLoc = case_when(cpLoc == "0.333333333" ~ 0.33,
                           cpLoc == "0.5" ~ 0.50,
                           cpLoc == "0.666666667" ~ 0.66)
         ) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)


emmeans(mod, ~ cpLoc | theta:sigma, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(contrast = case_when(contrast == "cpLoc0.333333333 / cpLoc0.5" ~ "early/mid",
                              contrast == "cpLoc0.333333333 / cpLoc0.666666667" ~ "early/late",
                              contrast == "cpLoc0.5 / cpLoc0.666666667" ~ "mid/late")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta, 
             color = contrast,
             shape = contrast
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = odds.ratio), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6)
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ ., 
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift",
       title = "Odds Ratio of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \nbetween the Change Point Locations",
       color = "",
       shape = "") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)
```
